findings.body: Evidence: .gitignore contains only .fusion/, .pi/, .worktrees/, fusion.db, fusion.db-wal, fusion.db-shm — no __pycache__ pattern. Step 4 runs `python3 -m compileall -q fusion-test2` and `python3 fusion-test2/test_add.py` (which imports add.py), both of which create fusion-test2/__pycache__/*.pyc. A broad `git add fusion-test2` would then stage those binaries, breaking the plan's own acceptance criteria ('git status --porcelain shows only the three new files'). Correction for the implementer: after the verification runs, delete fusion-test2/__pycache__ (or stage the three paths explicitly: `git add fusion-test2/add.py fusion-test2/test_add.py fusion-test2/README.md`), and re-check the staged file list before each commit. Do not add a .gitignore inside fusion-test2 or modify the root .gitignore, as both are out of scope.
